items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1979-12-05
items.q: And I got with a fellow named Melvin Banks and we got with a fellow named John Creech, Papa John Creech, he played up at the Roses. And we organized a group, we called ourselves the Chocolate Music Balls.

ctx.x: And in Chicago what type of music did you do?

Well, I got away from bands. They had a lot of three pieces, four pieces of combo in the yard. And I got with a fellow named Melvin Banks and we got with a fellow named John Creech, Papa John Creech, he played up at the Roses. And we organized a group, we called ourselves the Chocolate Music Balls. And we got jobs through bookings, some jobs came through the union, and we would go on, well, not tour, because we'd be working for a hotel chain, and we'd probably be, which would maybe be four weeks, six weeks, or…
Then I gather, well, like up in Chicago, you know, things started drying up a lot. I mean, it started.
